summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of Marketo MVP. 9/9 backend pytest tests passed and all 12 frontend flows in the review request passed via Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Order lifecycle (placed -> paid via mock -> shipped -> out_for_delivery -> delivered_confirmed via OTP -> disputed), Razorpay secret encryption/masking, subscription toggle affecting ad slot, register + create-store, forgot-password generic response, product with option group (Size), and Community-tier ad slot were all verified.

issues: Very minimal, unstyled inline-CSS UI (bare inputs, no visual hierarchy, no consistent spacing). Works but does not use shadcn/Tailwind for polish. Not blocking — likely intentional for MVP but worth noting for future UX pass.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 817 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, stores, products, orders, subscription) for maintainability.

OrderDetail wrong-OTP path emits a browser 400 error (expected) but there is no explicit attempt-count/lockout message rendered beyond backend detail; attempts counter shows only via reload. Minor UX nit.
Frontend uses inline styles throughout; shadcn components exist in /components/ui but pages don't leverage them. Fine for MVP.
BuyerOrder.js loads Razorpay checkout.js only on placed+non-mock; works but no cleanup on unmount.
